sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "TV_series"."Channel" AS e, "TV_Channel"."Country" AS g, AVG((CAST(("TV_series"."Share" - "TV_series"."Rating") AS REAL) / "TV_series"."Rating")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "TV_series" JOIN "TV_Channel" ON "TV_Channel"."id" = "TV_series"."Channel"  GROUP BY "TV_series"."Channel", "TV_Channel"."Country"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
quantities: TV_series.relative difference of household audience share from household rating
why: (household audience share - household rating) / household rating: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of household audience share from household rating per TV_Channel within TV_Channel.Country
share of the all total of number of TV_series records (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
